caption: The drawing features a small, dark brown or black dog with long, wavy fur, especially prominent around the ears and tail. The dog is lying down with its front legs extended and head raised, facing slightly toward the viewer’s left. It wears a pair of round, brown glasses and a blue bow around its neck. The background is completely plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery, giving the composition a minimalistic appearance. There are a few small, irregular marks scattered around the main figure. The artist's name, "John Wintour," is lightly inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Plush Toy Dog
